title: RBI's FEMA/FDI Reform Package
summary: Repatriable gift ceiling: $50,000 → **$250,000** (Liberalized Remittance Scheme), only to near relatives.

items: Repatriable gift ceiling: $50,000 → **$250,000** (Liberalized Remittance Scheme), only to near relatives.
Control redefined as ≥10% voting rights or policy/management control.
One-time RBI approval proposal for MFs/insurers/pension funds to raise bank stakes up to 10% (vs current per-instance 5% approval).
